notes.title: Wildlife Update!
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p][/p][p][b]The Wildlife Update is here![/b] Introducing neutral wildlife to Primordial Empire, this update features 9 new species of microbes and plants, and a brand new mechanic that allows more meaningful interactions than simply fighting them. Here are the update highlights:[/p][p][/p][h2]Wildlife[/h2][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/710415f28e22beacac72ef000139c19a38ddf2fa.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/7da13c029f1e515980f42c936c2cd7a4d5a911f6.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/cac91a4d8a3caeb1dc737036fc4cee567bb49712.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/468355b64c40dff5e91605c58428127e9e1bf921.png"][/img][/carousel][p]You can now find neutral wildlife scattered across the maps, sometimes forming a basic food chain or delicate ecosystems in various pockets. These new creatures possess their own unique abilities and habits:[/p][list][*][p]Cave Grass: Micro Agave in darkness have been replaced with Cave Grass (same mechanics but with a distinct look).[/p][/*][*][p]Witherleek: A wild plant native to fungal biomes, producing poisonous food particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Progenitor Cells/Pods: Ancestral wild forms of Stem Cells, often at the base of the food chain.[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Hunter Cells/Pods: Predators that prey on local wildlife such as Progenitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Nomad Cells & Egg Clutches: Scavenger-predators forming migratory routes between nests, often spanning great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Conjugator Cells/Pods: Exist in two types, A and B, which only reproduce when paired. How odd.[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Glowplant: Native to the Cave biome, these plants can generate light.[/p][/*][*][p]Uglets: Replacing Stabpoles as the spawn of the Big Ugly (identical stats).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Symbiosis[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/928595dbc637561b87407f3616ff1ed42f642bbc.png"][/img][/p][p]The neutral creatures are not always your competitors – they can be allies too! Incorporate them into your colony with the new befriending mechanic. Utilize their unique abilities and expand your microscopic empire with all the diverse life forms.[/p][p][/p][h2]New Biomes[/h2][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/bbada58a33f204b53dd4ca73c5ac0a5a4b19213a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/69d0225ae8f71161e33dc540d85abe488e5d8657.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/54da83aeb1014b99abb35c038e7304c7cf742f3c.png"][/img][/carousel][p]Biomes now have more distinct features that separate them from one another, including native wildlife and environmental modifiers. Play the bonus scenario to explore them all, now unlockable by completing the economic and combat scenarios at any rating![/p][p][/p][p]These new creatures have been in the works since the combat update so I'm very excited to finally add them to the demo. And of course, this update contains a myriad of optimizations and fixes, which can be found in the changelog at the end of this post.[/p][p]If you would like more insights to the new creatures and biomes, I'll be posting a couple guide videos on the [url="https://www.youtube.com/@PrimordialEmpire"]Primordial Empire YouTube channel[/url], so don't forget to check out the channel and subscribe to get the latest news of my game![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/4f481b9a6e47ac4f1ae4ae5ec530fefc82a7538a.png"][/img]  [/p][p][/p][h3]Full Changelog:[/h3][olist][*][p][b]Wildlife:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Cave Grass: Micro Agave in darkness have been replaced with Cave Grass (same mechanics but with a distinct look).[/p][/*][*][p]Witherleek: A wild plant native to fungal biomes, producing poisonous food particles.[/p][/*][*][p]Progenitor Cells/Pods: Ancestral wild forms of Stem Cells, often at the base of the food chain.[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Hunter Cells/Pods: Predators that prey on local wildlife such as Progenitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Nomad Cells & Egg Clutches: Scavenger-predators forming migratory routes between nests, often spanning great distances.[/p][/*][*][p]Conjugator Cells/Pods: Exist in two types, A and B, which only reproduce when paired. How odd.[/p][/*][*][p]Wild Glowplant: Native to the Cave biome, these plants can generate light.[/p][/*][*][p]Uglets: Replacing Stabpoles as the spawn of the Big Ugly (identical stats).[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Symbiosis[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Many neutral organisms can now be approached peacefully via the “Befriend” action. Invest resources to gain wildlife-specific bonuses (requires Neurons/Complexity to “understand” them).[/p][/*][*][p]Example bonuses:[/p][list][*][p]Free Stem Cell production (from Progenitor Pod),[/p][/*][*][p]Poisoned food becomes edible (from Witherleek),[/p][/*][*][p]Predators (Feeder Cells & Carnivorous Protein Factory) can hunt neutrals & enemies (from Wild Hunter),[/p][/*][*][p]Light sources activated in caves (from Wild Glowplant),[/p][/*][*][p]…and more,[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added Empathic Ganglion, a new growable plant (under "Development") that halves the Complexity cost of befriending neutrals,[/p][/*][*][p]Fighters (Lancet Cells, Hydras) received a configuration toggle to allow/ban automatic attacks on neutral wildlife. Shift-clicking toggles across all fighters,[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tutorial:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Tutorial 7 to introduce the befriending feature. Note: Depending on UI scale settings, you may need to scroll the tutorial list a bit for it to show,[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Biomes[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Biomes are now more distinct, featuring their own native wildlife and environmental modifiers (e.g., no natural light in caves). This will be most noticeable in the bonus scenario,[/p][/*][*][p]Bonus scenario now unlocked after beating the economic and combat scenarios at any star rating to make the wildlife and biome inclusions more accessible.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Fixes & QoL:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Background rendering overhaul (parallax-ready) - adds dynamic blur to the background layer depending on zoom level,[/p][/*][*][p]Added Steam screenshot support (F12),[/p][/*][*][p]Build tool configurations (e.g., enabled/disabled production chains) now save & load with scenarios,[/p][/*][*][p]Hunting configurations (e.g., allow/ban hunting Stem Cells) can now be shift-clicked to apply across all organisms of the same type, making colony-wide behavior toggles much faster,[/p][/*][*][p]ESC now correctly reverts to normal cursor mode,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where pressing Ctrl to show movement paths also highlighted enemy movement paths,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug where keyboard shortcuts (e.g. to replant remains) worked from within pause menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash when spamming R to rebuild multiple remains,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Carnivorous Protein Factories and Feeder Hubs rebuilt from remains not remembering hunting preferences.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare crash caused by the pathfinding system[/p][/*][*][p]Added second toggle to fighters to allow/ban attacking friendlies,[/p][/*][*][p]ProcGen avoids toxic patches during resource generation,[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorial 7 now remembers GUI element introduction steps after loading,[/p][/*][*][p]Added health indicator to friendly and own organisms' hover info panel (lower left corner)[/p][/*][/list][/*][/olist]

notes.title: Demo Combat Update ⚔️
notes.notes: [p][/p][previewyoutube="Aszt4TtvNKY;full"][/previewyoutube][p]Peaceful base-building is over! Primordial Empire just got a Combat Update, featuring a [b]new combat scenario[/b] with new enemies and challenges. Muster your army of lancet cells and prepare your defence. Protect your colony of microbes from the relentless attacks of hostile organisms![/p][p][/p][h3]Update Highlights:[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/39c150c8f782614062205f579daf2a79fdf92453.png"][/img]Introducing the Hydra, a static turret with powerful projectiles. This defensive plant is slumbering somewhere on the combat scenario map. Explore every nook and cranny to retrieve it and bolster your defence.[/p][p][/p][carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/d0bf4bcdc033460f0681666cba3dba9f08217d9c.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/b7c5049f876db0199ffa3bb6b0755678e74fce7f.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45435984/9c34be89364ec92caa3259ab19c83a839f946dca.png"][/img][/carousel][p]The enemies come with a well-equipped army of diverse units:[/p][list][*][p]Carnitubes - static structures (plants) hazardous to your wandering cells[/p][/*][*][p]Parasites and their Hives - "skirmishers" that harass and disrupt your colony[/p][/*][*][p]Stabpole - rank and file of the invaders. Attacks both cells and plants[/p][/*][*][p]Purgeling - a "siege unit" that can destroy plants with its devastating barrage[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There are also a myriad of optimizations and fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Improved control: Attractive Pheromones diffuse "around corners" (i.e. can now call Cells that have no direct line of sight if a path is still relatively easy to find)[/p][/*][*][p]Grubber Burrows now don't cost any upkeep[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced Lancet Hive mineral placement cost[/p][/*][*][p]Improved information about plants: what they see, what their reach is, etc. Plants like Grubber Burrows or Neurons show harvestable clusters/connections not only during build mode, but also when selecting existing plants. Same is true for Lumifloras' light cone.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed symbiotic feeding chain sometimes getting stuck not calling for Feeder Cells.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed radial menu tools disabling their control panel after repeated selection.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized several core functions, (e.g., wall collision resolving, drawing functions)[/p][/*][*][p]Bugfix: using combat warnings to jump to Carnitubes may crash the game[/p][/*][*][p]Improved recycle tool: More intuitive cell/plant selection behavior based on circle overlap with creatures. Improved clarity by highlighting selected creatures.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Outside of everything mentioned above, secrets lurk in the darkness of Primordial Empire. Can you find them?[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]And on that note, we shall conclude this patch notes. Feel free to let us know if you have any thoughts on the update or Primordial Empire as a whole. Every bit of feedback is crucial nutrition for our game to grow. Best of luck in your conquest of this microscopic world, and we look forward to bringing you more new content soon.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update Patch Notes - v0.1.4
notes.notes:
Thank you every for a cracking demo launch and Earth Appreciation Festival! We are fast approaching 5,000 wishlists which is a great milestone in such a short amount of time (if you haven't wishlisted already please do!)

With the demo launch has come a great amount of feedback and we've made some changes to the demo which we have outlined below :)

As always, please keep the feedback coming in and we will continue updating the demo as development progresses!

[list]
[*] New Vesicle Hubs start with Plasma-powered chain input filled
[*] Mineral Extractor's Symbiotic Feeding chain defaults to high priority
[*] Can now set hunting behavior of Feeder Hubs and Carnivorous Protein Factory (allow/ban hunting Stem Cells / Aminoberries)
[*] Micro Agave now starts with 50 calories; food production never drains calories below 50 --> much more robust against starvation, using Symbiotic Feeding alone now more viable
[*] Poison damage now bursts cells if they are at very low health
[*] Bursting cells drop their resources
[*] Enzyme- and Toxin production is now more lenient if inputs are delayed (1.2 -> 1.5 times the production duration as a "grace period" before the strategic resource becomes unavailable). Robust logistical setup still required, but will work much more reliably now.
[*] Lancet Hive no longer costs Toxins to build, houses 4 Lancet Cells.
[*] Can now switch between full screen and borderless window mode
[*] Updated main menu logo and splash screen
[*] Several minor bugfixes, most importantly: save/load system is now more robust when loading older save files.
[/list]

This means you should be able to jump right back into your previous colony. If you encounter any issues/crashes, please notify me! Thanks and have fun 🙂

P.S.: There's a small teaser included in the update. Can you find it?
